documents.rights_basis: Historical human English and original journal wording in the identified Philadelphia 1910 printing are public domain in the United States by expiration of the publication term. Modern Google introductory text and generated covers are excluded; faithful scan/OCR adds no original wording. This assessment concerns the actual historical printing, not merely the act date.
documents.rights_notice: Historical human English wording is public domain in the United States; later translations and host wrappers have separate status.
documents.source_note: English complete printed constituent, pp. 394–412. Anonymous historical human translation. Only two displaced OCR lines on printed p.404 are restored to their image-established paragraph positions: life. after sound doctrine and good, and literal ii.. 13) after (I. Thess. All source words, characters and historical OCR errors remain unchanged under the prior declared whitespace normalization. Other source order inherits the prior selection; no whole-printing word collation or comprehensive original-order claim is made.
